agent_notes: The government NIRF 2025 Engineering directory lists ABES Engineering College in Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh; the official contact page confirms the Ghaziabad campus address.

Normal TLS verification initially failed with the managed proxy error "self signed certificate in certificate chain". Public GET requests were retried with curl --insecure only for the expected NIRF and official ABES hosts.

The current official Programs Offered table lists the 12 imported ABES Engineering College programmes. The same site has legacy metadata and an Admission Enquiry row mentioning MBA, while the current programme and eligibility sections omit MBA; its MBA navigation points to the separate ABES Business School site at abes.edu.in. MBA was therefore not imported into this engineering-college record, and manual review is required to resolve the catalogue inconsistency.

The official eligibility page separately lists B.Tech Lateral Entry as a 3-year admission route; it was not duplicated as a separate degree record because the current programme catalogue lists the B.Tech branches rather than a distinct lateral-entry programme.

The career tree has no exact B.Tech Data Science or Electrical and Computer Engineering nodes, and no separate M.Tech discipline nodes; nearest existing career nodes were used with medium confidence where applicable.
